assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet for Bodega do Sadi, a warm detailed top-down 3/4 Brazilian rural RPG. Genuine transparent alpha background, crisp pixel clusters and dark outlines, restrained earth tones, no text, no UI, no grid, no frame border, no scene, no cast ground shadows. Each sprite FULLY isolated with generous empty gutters, no overlap, no cropping. EXACTLY 15 INVENTORY ICONS in FIVE columns by THREE rows, equal cells, visually centered, each fills about 70% of its cell. Match stylized game world sprites, readable at 48-64 pixels, no photorealism. Every object follows the same slightly overhead perspective. Row 1 left to right: (0) three old tarnished SILVER pirate coins stacked together, metallic pale silver not gold and not crystals; (1) small open burlap sack filled with angular coarse WHITE SALT crystals; (2) bunch of fresh rue herb with small rounded blue-green leaves tied with twine, distinct from mate; (3) two short lightweight pale-yellow garapuvu timber logs with brown bark and visible growth rings; (4) coiled rusty iron ANCHOR CHAIN with large oblong connected links. Row 2 left to right: (5) BROKEN naval sabre blade and remaining short hilt bundled together, jagged fracture clearly visible; (6) round dark old gunpowder bomb with short twisted fuse, NO detached sparks; (7) salt-and-rue protective charm: tiny white cloth pouch with two rue branches tied with green cord, small rough wooden cross attached; (8) a complete wide straight SILVER-edged machete with dark brown wood handle, diagonal, bright pale steel; (9) long wooden whaling HARPOON with a single silver barbed spear tip (NOT A TRIDENT) and coiled tan rope attached to butt, diagonal. Row 3 left to right: (10) old SINGLE-SHOT CARBINE with walnut stock, dark steel barrel, small silver sight, no scope, no magazine, diagonal; (11) open plain cardboard carton of waxed PAPER CARTRIDGES and two complete paper-wrapped cartridges beside it, no text; (12) complete gently curved NAVAL SABRE with silver guard and dark leather hilt, diagonal; (13) small CLOSED PIRATE CHEST with dark oak boards, aged iron bands and silver padlock, no coins outside; (14) low irregular deposit of coarse salt crystals on a gray coastal stone, no plants. All fifteen subjects separate, no duplicate items, no backgrounds.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet for Bodega do Sadi, a warm detailed top-down 3/4 Brazilian rural RPG. Genuine transparent alpha background, crisp pixel clusters and dark outlines, restrained earth tones, no text, no UI, no grid, no frame border, no scene, no cast ground shadows. Each sprite FULLY isolated with generous empty gutters, no overlap, no cropping. Use the two reference images ONLY to preserve Sadi's identity, outfit, proportions, and pixel art finish: adult man with thick curly brown hair, big mustache and short beard, red neckerchief, off-white rolled-sleeve shirt and short apron, dark gray bombacha trousers, brown boots, NO HAT. Do not turn him into a child. EXACTLY 12 full-body frames arranged in FOUR columns by THREE rows. Exactly the same head size, body height, outfit and boots baseline in all frames. Row 1 faces camera/south; row 2 is strict side profile facing RIGHT/east; row 3 shows back facing north. Four consecutive frames of the same action in each row. A left-facing version will be mirrored in code so do not include it. Fully visible feet and weapon in every cell. High-quality drawn anatomy, articulated shoulders elbows knees, matching original game's proportions. Action: Sadi fires and reloads an old single-shot CARBINE, walnut stock, long dark steel barrel, simple silver front sight, NO scope, NO magazine. In all three directional rows, columns left to right: 1 braced aim, stock against shoulder, both hands on gun, barrel straight toward intended facing; 2 brief recoil, shoulders lean back subtly and barrel raises a little, feet remain planted; 3 reload, muzzle lowered, right hand inserting one paper cartridge at breech while left hand supports rifle; 4 closes action and settles the same rifle into low ready, relaxed recovery. No separate bullets, no muzzle flash and no smoke (game draws effects). Keep torso height and leg lengths constant; firearm must read as a long carbine, never a pistol. The side-row weapon can extend right within cell but must not touch adjacent pose. The rear-row rifle projects above/right shoulder visibly, no face in back view.
